text: Resins your production can count on. MPD Industries, Ujjain: 22 reactors, nearly 83,000 tons a year, built to keep your lines running. Plant 1 makes saturated polyester, alkyds and modified epoxy, in reactors up to 16 KL. Plant 2 adds reactive polyamides, powder polyesters, acrylic polyols and phenolics, as flakes or pellets. Need a custom grade? We develop it with you, from 2 KL trials to full batches. And supply you can plan around: raw materials stocked in bulk, and 600 KL of solvents underground. Over 1,000 KL of finished resin waits in 22 grade-dedicated tanks, ready to ship. Short lead times. Steady deliveries. Recipe-driven automation makes every batch match the last. Our QC lab releases each one, and our application lab tests it the way you will use it. Heat from agro-waste biomass, not coal. 0.7 MW of rooftop solar. Effluent treated on site. Lower-carbon resin for your sustainability goals. Reliable supply, consistent quality, and technical support from people who know your process. MPD Industries. We innovate. We serve.
